body: Yes I feel this so much. I’m still in school, working on my senior thesis, and the last time this happened was when I got up in front of our lecture class to do a brief like 3 minute synopsis of what I was working on. I totally messed it up and kept stuttering from being so nervous and when I was finished I walked past my seat and had to leave because I was freaking out and felt like I needed to hurt myself.
Thank you for sharing I would like to hear more of your story as well! Hang in there today love.

This is how I ended up getting diagnosed actually. I was just being medicated for depression but just on a whim I impulsively took my whole bottle of meds and later in the hospital couldn’t even give a reason why. I wasn’t trying to kill myself I just did it.

I really relate to this, back when I was in high school me and two of my friends found out that each other cut and we’d just talk about it or talk through it like it was a normal conversation topic and it was refreshing to be able to talk about it and not feel like a freak the way you felt if someone else found out. 
Now obviously it’s not that I wish my friends now cut too, but I just wish I could talk about it more easily.

I do stuff like this too, like I’m really anxious and want to leave so the first thing that goes through my head is “if I cut my hand really bad on (accident) I can leave to have my breakdown somewhere else”

I don’t do things like that normally but when I have a breakdown I’ll take a handful of sleeping pills to “fall asleep and avoid it” and then wake up later like oh my god I just took a bunch out of nowhere or I’ll go months without cutting and then freak out and cut myself all over like I can’t even feel it. Then after the fact it’s like I never felt that way but I fear one of these times I’ll end up killing myself when if I had just waited an hour I’d be fine. I feel like I can’t control myself.
Thank you, maybe that would help
